goal.stated_goal: Work out how to justify my prices when clients show up with AI mockups.
goal.diagnosed_goal: Within 18 months, shift the project mix so more revenue comes from concept and brand-direction work that clients buy for judgment, and less from production volume.
goal.divergence_note: The stated goal is defending prices; the diagnosis is that one bundled fee hides which part of the work clients value (UQ03 resolved at intake: all projects are priced as one fee).
success_signals: At least a third of new projects quoted with a separate concept fee
Fewer projects where revision hours exceed concept hours

baseline.main_concern: Clients use AI mockups to push prices down and question what concept work is worth.

role.sector_band: Small consumer food and drink brands

employer_ai_policy.notes: No employer; some client contracts require original work and no generative AI without consent, others are silent.

constraints.statement: Nothing that signals to clients that work is being automated or corners cut; can't risk losing a client.
Small monthly tool budget only if it pays back.

capabilities.statement: Long-standing client relationships; several repeat clients.

first_experiment.title: Where your hours went on your last 3 projects (two short sittings)

hypothesis.statement: Concept work is under 30% of your hours but drives which clients stay, while production and revisions are where your effective hourly rate is lowest.
hypothesis.would_be_wrong_if: Concept is already 40% or more of your hours, or production-heavy projects have your best effective rates.

relevance.why_for_this_user: Last week showed a single 60-minute sitting doesn't fit around rush jobs, so this is the same question in two 15-minute pieces.

steps.instruction: Sitting 1: for your last 3 finished projects, estimate hours for concept, production and revisions in the template.
Sitting 2: work out each project's relative effective rate, and note which phase the happiest client valued.

materials.description: The user's own project records, reviewed locally; only totals and ratios are recorded; no tool is used.

prediction.user: Same as before: production about half, revisions bigger than I think.
prediction.engine: Same expectation; fewer projects means a weaker signal, so B3 (mixed) is more likely.

Projects where revision hours exceeded concept hours
